findings.text: Home accounts for $17,769,798.56 in incurred losses versus $15,905,156.32 for Auto, making Home the larger line by total incurred cost.
Auto carries the higher open case reserve at $2,129,196.20 compared with $1,910,942.75 for Home, suggesting more unsettled Auto claims relative to its paid activity.

Incurred losses are highly skewed: the median claim is $4,070.27 while the mean is $7,974.14 and the largest single claim reaches $280,846.70, indicating a small number of large losses pull the average well above the typical claim.

Month-over-month incurred losses fell 70.4% from Jul 2026 to Aug 2026, though the chart shows a 5.8% rise in Aug versus Jul — these signals disagree and both are noted; the partial September data is excluded from comparisons.
